name: Deaths Breath Doors (CR 8)
body:
Death’s Breath Doors
CR 8

XP 4,800

Source: Pathfinder #8

Type magical Perception DC 25; Disable Device DC 25

EFFECTS

Trigger touch; Reset automatic (after 1 minute); Bypass each door can be neutralized for one round with a successful turning attempt against a 6 HD target (a destruction result destroys the trap)

Effect Atk +14 melee (scythe; 2d4+9/×4; all targets within 5 feet of any door) and poison gas (insanity mist; inhaled Fort DC 15; initial 1d4 Wis, secondary 2d6 Wis; all creatures in area G1)
